text:
Leah (CSM): Quick sync: Pre-cutover alignment with Harborline scheduled Tues 9:30am ET. Main topics: VPC peering vs TGW, cross-account role ARNs, customer-managed KMS policy, audit-log bucket retention & lifecycle, renewal-risk milestones (SLA proof window). Can folks confirm? Need any pre-reads? @Tomas @Priya @Victor

Tomas (Solutions Eng): I'm in. I'll bring a small checklist + a network diagram showing two patterns (peering and TGW) and a short perf note about asymmetric routing we saw with transit attachments. Also will include an example assume-role policy we ask customers to create.

Priya (Infra Eng): FYI for KMS: if Harborline wants a CMK we require key policy entries for our service principal and the assume-role principal. Recommend a single CMK for S3/Bucket encryption and CloudTrail SSE-KMS unless they require separate keys for separation of duties.

Victor (Harborline SRE): Prefer separate CMKs for logs vs data. We also have a compliance ask for 180-day immutable retention on a subset of audit objects. Can Redwood's S3 sink support Object Lock with Governance mode?

Priya (Infra Eng): Short answer: we can write to a bucket with Object Lock enabled if Harborline owns the bucket and grants us Write/PutObject/PutObjectRetention permissions. But Object Lock needs to be enabled at bucket creation and can't be toggled later. We'll need the bucket ARN and confirmation it's created with lock enabled. Also need to know if they want SSE-KMS with CMK ARN(s).

Leah (CSM): Action items: Victor to share bucket ARN + whether Object Lock enabled, Harborline AWS account ID and preferred role name. Tomas to post assume-role snippets and a minimal key policy example in the invite. Priya to draft quick KMS decision matrix (single vs multiple keys + rotation implications). Ill also surface renewal milestone idea: 30-day SLA pilot with latency SLOs and customer success checkpoints at Day 7/14/28.

Tomas (Solutions Eng): Posting pre-read: assume-role sample below (they should replace ACCOUNT_ID and EXTERNAL_ID):

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:role/HarborlineRedwoodAssume"},
      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
      "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"sts:ExternalId": "EXTERNAL_ID"}}
    }
  ]
}
```

Tomas (Solutions Eng): Also adding route table snippet we ask for in pre-reads (private subnet -> interface endpoint routes).

onboard-bot: Reminder: upload runbook snapshot here: https://redwood.example/onboarding/private-vpc/runs/2026-03-18 (read-only).

Victor (Harborline SRE): One operational note: Harborline runs an egress proxy (squid) on a pair of NAT instances. We need to coordinate health-check IPs and TLS interception behavior. Our security team is particularly sensitive to outbound certificate pinning failures.

Priya (Infra Eng): Ok noted. We'll provide a short doc on TLS passthrough expectations and agent health-check IP ranges. Please confirm whether the proxy modifies Host headers for outbound requests. If it does we may need custom health-check endpoints.

Leah (CSM): Renewal risk flag: Victor, you mentioned latency spikes during our sandbox run. If the 30-day pilot doesn't meet the SLOs we'll capture specifics in a joint RCA and discuss mitigation (tuning batching/quantization, dedicated capacity). Planning to log this as a potential renewal risk if not resolved by pilot end. We'll track it in the account health dashboard.

Victor (Harborline SRE): Understood. We'll try to get baseline perf numbers from our internal tests and share them before the call. Also want a short enablement session for our on-call next week post-cutover.

Tomas (Solutions Eng): Noted. I'll schedule a 60-min deep-dive runbook walkthrough for their on-call and include troubleshooting playbooks + sample logs to look for.

Leah (CSM): Calendar updated. Final pre-req checklist I put in the invite: account ID, bucket ARN (if pre-created), preferred role name, CIDR ranges for workloads, list of egress proxy IPs, and whether Object Lock=enabled. If anyone needs to add items comment here.

calendar-bot: Meeting created Tue 9:30am ET; invite with attachments sent to participants.

Leah (CSM): Thanks all. I'll compile the pre-reads and ping again 24h before. If Harborline provides ARNs early we can pre-validate key policies to avoid blockers on cutover. :white_check_mark:
